simple.summary: נָקַע (nâqaʻ) means to feel aversion First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 18.

definitions.full: H5361. naqa [ נָקַע ] verb be [severed, figurative] alienated, estranged (compare Arabic split, rend, sacrifice RS Semitic i. 471 f.; 2d ed. 491 ; Ethiopic split up, open (intransitive) Di 647 ; Late Hebrew נֶקַע cleft, Syriac id. ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular מֵעַל נַפְשִׁי נָָֽקְעָה Ezek 23:18 my soul was estranged from her sister (|| יָקַע ), compare 23:22 ; 23:28 (both with מִן ).
